title: Hydraulic Ram Capacity
description: A bridge is to be jacked up to replace its bearings. The design requires a hydraulic ram with a minimum capacity of 1,000 kilonewtons (kN). The hydraulic rams that are available are rated in tons (2,000 lb/ton). The minimum size (tons) ram to use is most nearly:
hint: Identify the core variables and check the NCEES Reference Handbook for the governing equation.
shortcut: Check the multiple-choice answers first! Eliminate outliers based on the magnitude of your inputs.
fifthGrader: Think about this like a simple balancing puzzle. We are just using math to figure out how much weight or water it takes to tip the scale.
